title: Safety and security: what Phase 1 taught

cards.title: The model is an input, not a user
cards.text: Guard where model text becomes something that acts: fail closed, allow-lists, enforcement in code.

cards.title: Three doors closed
cards.text: A host with no key won't start, git takes values as data, a written skill waits for /approve.

cards.title: A door beside the gate
cards.text: One open identity, a few sessions a day from one address; the gate itself unchanged.

cards.title: Accounts and credentials
cards.text: An HttpOnly cookie with a header, providers, passkeys and two-factor.

cards.title: A tool with a side effect
cards.text: SendLead checks its input and sends once, on the visitor's yes.

cards.title: Privacy and trust pages
cards.text: Every line read off the code; every gap named as Not yet.
